import ast,copy,hashlib,json,math,sys
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8');R=Path.cwd();O=Path(__file__).parent;sys.path.insert(0,str(R))
from experiments.retrieval_diagnostics.mechanics import Mechanics
from tests.experiments.retrieval_diagnostics.helpers import capture
from experiments.identifier_sparse.analysis import query_terms,iter_terms
from experiments.bm25_sensitivity.metrics import completion
from devtools.context.localization import LocalizationTaskInterpretation,LocalizationTaskIdentity,TaskProvenance,LocalizationObligation,LocalizationObligationIdentity,RequirementStatus,SatisfactionCriterion,WitnessSet,LocalizationAssessment,Disposition,SupportedWitness,LocalizationEvidenceReference,assess_localization_readiness
from devtools.context.repository.identity import RepositoryId
from devtools.context.repository.snapshot import RepositorySnapshotId
out=[]
def add(name,**details):out.append(dict(name=name,**details))
# Only tiny independently authored fixtures, no frozen outcomes or controllers.
c=capture((('a.py','plain plain'),('b.py','plain other other other')),query='plain',limit=100)
assert c.rows[0].score>c.rows[1].score
bad=replace(c,rows=(replace(c.rows[1],rank=1),),complete_positive_universe=False)
e=Mechanics(bad); omitted=e.explain(c.rows[0].resource)
assert omitted['status']=='RESULT_BOUND_OMISSION' and omitted['score']>bad.rows[0].score
add('bounded_capture_accepts_nonprefix',accepted=True,returned=bad.rows[0].resource.address.value,claimed_rank=1,omitted_better=c.rows[0].resource.address.value,omitted_status=omitted['status'],higher_omitted_score=omitted['score'],returned_score=bad.rows[0].score)
try:Mechanics(replace(bad,complete_positive_universe=True))
except ValueError as exc:add('complete_capture_rejects_same_omission',error=str(exc))
else:raise AssertionError('Full capture accepted missing positive')
assert Mechanics(replace(c,rows=c.rows[:1],complete_positive_universe=False)).rows.keys()=={c.rows[0].resource.address.value}
add('genuine_bounded_prefix_supported',accepted=True)
for text,expected in [('HTTPClient2Parser',('httpclient2parser','http','client','2','parser')),('candidate_candidate',('candidate_candidate','candidate')),('___',('___',)),('ÉclairHTTP2',('éclairhttp2','éclair','http','2'))]:
 assert query_terms(text)==expected;add('independent_identifier_'+text,expected=expected)
assert tuple(iter_terms('candidate_candidate candidate'))==('candidate_candidate','candidate','candidate')
add('source_occurrences_preserved_query_duplicates_removed',source=list(iter_terms('candidate_candidate candidate')),query=list(query_terms('candidate candidate')))
assert completion((('a',('one','two')),('b',('three','four'))),{'one':1,'four':2}) is None
add('incompatible_witnesses_not_combined',completion=None)
# Present limitation, not proposed architecture implementation: supplied frame can be READY.
fixture_objective='Preserve owner checks. Add a boundary regression using native fixtures.'
taskid=LocalizationTaskIdentity('audit-two-clause-task');repo=RepositoryId.new();snap=RepositorySnapshotId('a'*64);target='caller-reviewed-existing-contract'
ob=LocalizationObligation(LocalizationObligationIdentity(taskid,'preserve-owner'), 'Preserve owner checks',(),TaskProvenance('audit-task-v1'),RequirementStatus.MANDATORY,SatisfactionCriterion('owner','Existing owner checks retained'),(WitnessSet((target,)),))
task=LocalizationTaskInterpretation(taskid,TaskProvenance('audit-task-v1'),(),(ob,))
assessment=LocalizationAssessment(ob.identity,repo,snap,Disposition.RESOLVED,supported_witnesses=(SupportedWitness(target,(LocalizationEvidenceReference('audit-caller-review',repo,snap),)),))
ready=assess_localization_readiness(task=task,repository_id=repo,snapshot_id=snap,assessments=(assessment,))
assert ready.is_ready
add('readiness_does_not_discover_omitted_second_task_clause',fixture_objective=fixture_objective,supplied_obligations=1,fixture_task_clauses=2,readiness=ready.readiness.value,interpretation='Expected scoped contract, not a readiness bug; no claim of exhaustive task understanding')
src=(O/'probes.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8');result=dict(source=src,source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(src.encode()).hexdigest(),passed=len(out),results=out)
(O/'probes.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=True,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(dict(passed=len(out),results=out),indent=2))

results.name: readiness_does_not_discover_omitted_second_task_clause
results.fixture_objective: Preserve owner checks. Add a boundary regression using native fixtures.
results.interpretation: Expected scoped contract, not a readiness bug; no claim of exhaustive task understanding
